title: Register New World as its own theme: id new-world, --nw-* tokens, theme contract entry, hidden

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: New World is the new mega template, default theme for every new Space

detail:
Separate from Services (id `services`, untouched). Adds NEW_WORLD_TOKENS_CSS (three tiers: Frequency core verbatim, alias tier, scoped data-th night|day registers, OKLCH accents with vividness), themes.New World in theme-contract.json, the editor theme, the manifest at schema 2, and the SiteThemeId. Coordinate with the Services thread, which edits site-style.ts registration. Theme fence: tokens scoped to [data-house-theme="new-world"], stand-alone site render only.

Registered on top of the Services registration (#4513). Tokens are --nw-* as the intake rules map them (Network's own --nw-* names live under a different scope, [data-house-theme="network"], so they never meet). Daniel's ruling 2026-11-03 01:53Z: the starting accent is Tide teal, so the flare ramps (--n-flare, --d-flare) are Tide, not the zip's violet; the Stage inks are Frequency's slate, not the zip's violet-tinted scale, because the violet family is retired (ADR-1792, scripts/probes/violet-family.mjs). Both are named as deviations in docs/design-systems/new-world/rules.json. Hidden from every picker (RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS) until chrome and blocks ship (LIVE-2055) and the default flips (LIVE-2058). Fonts (Unbounded, Hanken Grotesk, Instrument Serif) register with LIVE-2055. Extra accents wait on Daniel.
